features: See what's new: when you come back after an update, a Release Notes window now shows you what changed since your last visit.
Click the version number at the bottom of any page to read the Release Notes for every past version.

Sort your expense and income tables by date, name or amount: click the arrow next to a column heading to sort from lowest to highest, click again to sort from highest to lowest, and click a third time to go back to the original order.
Search your expense and income tables: type in the search bar above a table to show only the rows whose name or amounts match what you typed.
